subject: Hosted API evaluation — quick demo to review your eval
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Park <sarah@atlashealth.io>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 15:23:00 -0700 (PDT)
Subject: Hosted API evaluation — quick demo to review your eval

Hi Sarah,

Thanks for signing up to evaluate Redwood Hosted API — I saw Atlas Health started a Hosted API eval this morning (nice work). I wanted to see if you’d be open to a short 30-min demo so we can walk through your specific evaluation goals and make sure the hosted setup is tuned for your use case (latency targets, data controls, and expected throughput).

A few quick options next week that work on my side:
- Wed Aug 12, 10:00am PT / 1:00pm ET
- Thu Aug 13, 11:00am PT / 2:00pm ET
- Fri Aug 14, 9:30am PT / 12:30pm ET

If none of those work, here’s my calendly to pick a time: https://calendly.com/marissa-redwood/30min

Do you expect anyone else from your team to join? It’s helpful to have an engineering or infra owner on the call if you’re looking at performance/latency tradeoffs. I’ve cc’d Alex (our AE) who can join to cover pricing and rollout options.

Attaching a short guide we typically send to PLG evaluation leads — includes checklist items (API keys, sample payloads to test, metrics to watch).

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
SDR, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
[attachment: hosted-api-eval-guide.pdf (application/pdf)]

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the quick follow-up.

We’d love a short walkthrough. Two times that look good from our side:
- Wed Aug 12, 10:00am PT (works for me)
- Thu Aug 13, 11:00am PT (backup)

Tom Nguyen (engineering) will join — he’ll want to talk about throughput and KV cache behavior. Will Alex be on the call as well?

Quick Q: are you able to share any example prompts or payload shapes that typically surface latency/regression risk for the Hosted API?

Thanks,
Sarah Park

sarah@atlashealth.io

Perfect — let’s lock in Wed Aug 12 at 10:00am PT. I’ve sent a calendar invite to the email addresses on the thread and added Tom as requested. Alex will join to cover pricing/rollout.

I’m also attaching a short mutual action plan template that we can edit on the call — it helps us align on success criteria, data needs, and next steps (quick wins: sampling latency at peak qps, prefix caching config, and a recommended quantization profile for your model).

Example payloads to test: short generative prompts (~50 tokens), long chain-of-thought prompts (~600 tokens), and embedding batches (50–100 items). The attached guide has a small checklist and a few cURL snippets you can paste into your test harness.

HubSpot with the eval details: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/ATL-2026-089
Calendly (if you need to reschedule): https://calendly.com/marissa-redwood/30min

Looking forward — talk Wed.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
